hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the checkout pod will cause the checkout service to be unavailable, leading to failed order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service for the workflow; its pod is a single replica and directly handles order placement.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; killing checkout will break this invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/checkout, observe order responses, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, checkout service becomes available and workflow can succeed again.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the cart pod will cause cart service unavailability, breaking the AddItem step and preventing order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service for the workflow; its pod is a single replica and is required for adding items.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires successful AddItem before PlaceOrder; killing cart will break this invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/cart, observe AddItem failures, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, cart service becomes available and workflow can succeed again.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 500ms network delay to checkout pod will cause timeouts in order placement, leading to failed workflow.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; network delay increases response time and may cause client timeouts.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; delay may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on workload/checkout, observe order response times, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After removing delay, checkout service returns to normal and workflow can succeed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 500ms network delay to cart pod will cause AddItem timeouts, preventing successful order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service; delay in cart calls may cause the checkout workflow to fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires successful AddItem; delay may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on workload/cart, observe AddItem response times, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After removing delay, cart service returns to normal and workflow can succeed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 50% network loss to checkout pod will cause intermittent failures in order placement, breaking the workflow.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; packet loss may cause request failures and retries.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; loss will cause failures and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_loss on workload/checkout, observe order failures, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After removing loss, checkout service returns to normal and workflow can succeed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 50% network loss to cart pod will cause AddItem failures, preventing successful order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service; loss may cause AddItem requests to fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires successful AddItem; loss will cause failures and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_loss on workload/cart, observe AddItem failures, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After removing loss, cart service returns to normal and workflow can succeed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stressing CPU on checkout pod will degrade performance, causing timeouts and failed order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; CPU stress may slow down request processing.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; CPU stress may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject container_cpu_stress on workload/checkout, observe order response times, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After stopping stress, checkout service returns to normal and workflow can succeed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stressing CPU on cart pod will degrade AddItem performance, causing timeouts and preventing order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service; CPU stress may slow down AddItem processing.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires successful AddItem; CPU stress may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject container_cpu_stress on workload/cart, observe AddItem response times, then recover and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After stopping stress, cart service returns to normal and workflow can succeed.
